title: What happens after I start using LabourFlow?
description: From setting up your consultancy and team to managing clients, compliance, payroll, documents and statutory work, LabourFlow brings your daily operations into one connected flow.

steps.title: Set Up Consultancy & Team
steps.shortDescription: Set up your consultancy, team members and access permissions.
steps.description: Create your consultancy account, add firm details and branding, then invite managers, executives and HR staff with role-based access and module permissions.

steps.title: Client Management
steps.shortDescription: Manage companies, branches and client information from one workspace.
steps.description: Add client companies, branches and contact details to one centralized workspace with smart search and organized records.

steps.title: Documents & Records
steps.shortDescription: Organize important client documents and track their expiry dates.
steps.description: Upload GST, PAN, licences, agreements and other client records with expiry dates, version history and fast search, ready for renewal reminders.

steps.title: Compliance Configuration
steps.shortDescription: Configure the labour laws and requirements applicable to each client.
steps.description: Configure the labour laws and statutory requirements that apply to each client based on their industry, establishment and workforce.

steps.title: Compliance Calendar & Tasks
steps.shortDescription: Track recurring compliance deadlines and assign work to your team.
steps.description: Automatically organize PF, ESI, PT, LWF, returns and licence renewals for every client, then assign each deadline to the right consultant or staff member.

steps.title: Employee Management
steps.shortDescription: Maintain employee records and workforce information for every client.
steps.description: Maintain employee records including UAN, ESIC details, salary structure, bank details and other workforce data for each client.

steps.title: Payroll Processing
steps.shortDescription: Process attendance, payroll and required statutory calculations.
steps.description: Upload attendance, calculate salaries and process PF, ESI, PT, LWF, bonus and gratuity with the required statutory calculations.

steps.title: Statutory Outputs
steps.shortDescription: Generate payslips, challans, ECR files and compliance reports.
steps.description: Generate payslips, PF ECR files, ESI outputs, PT challans and other statutory reports required for client compliance.

steps.title: Client Portal
steps.shortDescription: Give clients a secure space to access compliance information and submit documents.
steps.description: Share reports and compliance status with clients through a secure web and mobile-friendly space where they can upload documents and check deadlines.

steps.title: Notices & Reminders
steps.shortDescription: Track notices, renewals and expiries with timely client reminders.
steps.description: Track government notices, reply deadlines, licence renewals and document expiries while sending timely WhatsApp and email reminders.
